evidence.title: TaskHandoff packages/app-runtime/src/managed-app-definitions/codex/runtime.ts
evidence.finding: CodexRuntimeExtension launches a shared codex app-server, binds a Unix or authenticated WebSocket listener and attaches TTY sessions through a per-session proxy.

evidence.title: TaskHandoff packages/app-runtime/src/managed-app-definitions/opencode/runtime.ts
evidence.finding: OpenCodeRuntimeExtension launches opencode serve on loopback with random credentials, waits for health and attaches terminals to the shared server.

evidence.title: TaskHandoff apps/mobile/src/repository/RepositoryDiffView.tsx
evidence.locator: RepositoryDiffView; SplitCodeLine; inline code line renderer
evidence.finding: The mobile repository view renders actual before/after line.content through RepositoryCodeText, line numbers, addition/deletion markers and expandable context in split/inline views.

evidence.title: TaskHandoff packages/control-plane-ui/src/apps/control-plane/story/StoryActionAutomations.vue
evidence.finding: The Story automation interface lists schedules, effective status, next run, run-history sessions and run/enable/edit controls.

evidence.title: TaskHandoff controlled-instance-rs/crates/workspace/src/triggers/schedule.rs
